fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BlastFurnace:
Allows refinement of <itemName id=|CopperIngot|/>.
The quality leaves much to desire, and processing is slow.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BlastFurnace2:
Allows refinement of <itemName id=|IronIngot|/>.
The quality has improved, but the processing speed is still unsatisfactory.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BlastFurnace3:
Allows refinement of <itemName id=|StealIngot|/>.
It requires electricity to use, but is quicker to process.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_CampFire:
Needed for cooking food.
It can only be used to grill simple ingredients.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_CharacterRankUp:
A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank.
Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given
a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_CookingStove:
Needed for cooking food.
Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseGatlingGun:
A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies.
It fires high-powered ammunition.
Deploy a Pal to it to prepare for battle.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseMachinegun:
Deploy a Pal to operate this defensive installation.
Requires <itemName id=|RifleBullet|/> to use.
Place ammo in the chest, and the deployed Pal will automatically load the weapon.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseMissile:
Deploy a Pal to operate this defensive installation.
Requires <itemName id=|ExplosiveBullet|/> to use.
Place ammo in the chest, and the deployed Pal will automatically load the weapon.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseBowGun:
Deploy a Pal to operate this defensive installation.
Requires <itemName id=|Arrow|/> to use.
Place ammo in the chest, and the deployed Pal will automatically load the weapon.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseWait:
Defensive installation to protect a base from enemies.
Place a Pal and it will ignore other work
to stay on lookout and prepare for combat.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DisplayCharacter:
Container for observing captured Pals.
Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production,
but they do not become hungry.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ElectricGenerator:
A power generator fueled by Electric Pals.
Electric equipment won't run without this.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ElectricKitchen:
Needed for cooking food.
It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Factory_Hard_01:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
A small workspace limits production speeds.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Factory_Hard_02:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Factory_Hard_03:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FarmBlockV2_wheet:
A farm that can grow <itemName id=|Wheat|/>.
It requires an average amount of time to harvest.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FarmBlockV2_tomato:
A farm that can grow <itemName id=|Tomato|/>.
They take time to harvest, but increase the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FarmBlockV2_Lettuce:
A farm that can grow <itemName id=|Lettuce|/>.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FarmBlockV2_Berries:
A farm that can grow <itemName id=|Berries|/>.
Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FastTravelPoint:
A stone monument in the shape of a <characterName id=|ChickenPal|/>.
Allows fast travel to the location where it is placed.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ItemChest:
Stores items.
Made from wood, it breaks easily.
It's probably not the best thing to store valuables in.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ItemChest_02:
Stores items.
Reinforced with metal, it is somewhat durable.
The increased size allows for the storage of more things.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ItemChest_03:
Stores items.
Made of iron, it is extremely durable.
It is useful as a large, secure storage box.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicalPalBed_02:
A straw bed for Pals.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
It isn't soft, but it's better than nothing.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicalPalBed_03:
A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
Pals love sleeping on fluffy beds like this.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicalPalBed_04:
A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on.
Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night.
Even large Pals can sleep soundly on a bed like this.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicineFacility_01:
A facility for making Pal medicine.
It can only produce simple medicines.
Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicineFacility_02:
A facility for making Pal medicine.
It requires electricity, but can produce high quality medicine.
Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PalFoodBox:
A box for storing Pal food.
Pals can feed from it when hungry.
Make sure to keep it well-stocked to keep your Pals happy.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PalStorage:
Used for storing captured Pals.
A base is formed with this at the center.
Make a base just for you and your Pals.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PalBoxV2:
Facility for storing captured Pals.
Pals inside gradually recover Health.
Area around this facility becomes a base.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PlayerBed_02:
A shoddy bed for humans.
Use it when injured or to sleep at night.
You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PlayerBed_03:
A fluffy bed for humans.
Use it when injured or to sleep at night.
You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_SphereFactory_Black_01:
A <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
A small workspace keeps the production speed slow.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_SphereFactory_Black_02:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_SphereFactory_Black_03:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_StonePit:
A facility for producing <itemName id=|Stone|/>.
Mining <itemName id=|Stone|/> is hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_CopperMine:
A facility for producing <itemName id=|CopperOre|/>.
Mining <itemName id=|CopperOre|/> is extremely hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WeaponFactory_Dirty_01:
A <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> for producing weapons and ammunition.
A small workspace prevents the production of high quality weapons.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WeaponFactory_Dirty_02:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WeaponFactory_Dirty_03:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WorkBench:
A <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> for producing simple items.
Requires a Pal that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_RecoverOtomo:
Used for recovering a Pal's Health.
Soothes and calms a Pal inside their sphere using Paldium.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_HatchingPalEgg:
Used for incubating a Pal Egg.
If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_StationDeforest2:
A facility for producing <itemName id=|Wood|/>.
Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance.
Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WorkBench_SkillUnlock:
A <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> for producing Pal tools.
Make a saddle to ride Pals, or make a gun for Pals to use.

Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base.

Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_LargeCeilingLamp:

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BuildableGoddessStatue:
Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island.

Facility where Pals on base can rest.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Spa2:
Facility where Pals on base can rest.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_DefenseWall:
Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Crusher:
Facility for breaking down <itemName id=|Stone|/> and <itemName id=|Wood|/> to exchange them for other materials.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WoodCrusher: Facility that can saw <itemName id=|Wood|/> to extract <itemName id=|Fiber|/>.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FlourMill:

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Snowman:

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ItemBooth:
A facility for selling items.
By setting products in the sales list, you can sell items to other players.
Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PalBooth:
A facility for selling Pals.
By setting Pals in the sales list, you can sell them to other players.
Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_FarmBlockV2_Carrot:
A farm where you can grow <itemName id=|Carrot|/>.
It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare.
Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_SphereFactory_Black_04:
An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, allowing for the production of spheres at high speed.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MultiElectricHatchingPa:
Device for incubating Pal eggs.
While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_HugeKitchen:
Needed for cooking food.
By becoming larger, multiple Pals can cooperate to cook together.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Factory_Hard_04:
An Assembly Line for producing items and gear.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed production.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WeaponFactory_Dirty_04:
An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition.
Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed weapon production.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_SanityDecrease1:
A device that emits alpha waves to help Pals relax.
Slows the rate at which the SAN value of Base Pals decreases.
Placing more than one has no additional effect.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_WorkSpeedIncrease1:
A device that emits beta waves to energize Pals.
Increases the work speed of Base Pals.
Placing more than one has no additional effect.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_QuartzPit:
A facility for producing <itemName id=|Quartz|/>. 
Mining <itemName id=|Quartz|/> is grueling physical work.
Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Factory_Money:
An Assemby Line that manufactures Money. 
The work puts a strain on the mind, causing a decrease in Pal's SAN value.
Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ItemChest_04:
Stores items.
Quite sturdy, with plenty of storage space.
It is useful as a large, secure storage box.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicalPalBed_05:
A healing pod for Pals.
Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night.
Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BaseCampItemDispenser: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_GuildChest:
A chest that can instantly send and receive items through subspace. 
The items inside are shared across all bases where it is placed.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Expedition:
A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. 
The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Lab:
A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. 
By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_OperatingTable: A facility where surgery can be performed on Pals to change their gender or passive skills.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_ManualElectricGenerator:
A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy.
The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Farm_SkillFruits:
A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated.
By planting the original fruit in the ground,
multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Wooden_ladder: A ladder that allows you to climb to a slightly higher place.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PalMedicineBox: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_EnergyStorage_Electric: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the <mapObjectName id=|ElectricGenerator|/>.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_BlastFurnace4:
Allows refinement of <itemName id=|StainlessSteel|/>.
By growing in size, multiple Pals can collaborate to perform smelting.
Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_MedicineFacility_03:
A facility for making medicine to cure Pals' illnesses. 
With advanced technology, it can also create unknown medicines. 
Assign the task to a Pal capable of pharmacy work.
fields.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Headstone:
